meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have twenty minutes, Hale, and I'd like to know why my son found out about a zero from his phone in the middle of class.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says not to use it alone, so what else do you have, Hale?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale?
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening my son's record because I asked a question. I'm writing that down, Hale. Procedure 4.4 says a first concern gets a supervised reassessment and nothing in the record, so which rule are you using?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that you apologise for how Owen found out, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed, still demanding the zero withdrawn.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "I'll have to put it on his permanent record", because it threatened the one thing she never trades and sounded like punishment for her questions.
Try next time: after her first question about Owen finding out from his phone, own the zero going in before the call home in one sentence, then offer a dated document instead of the 94% score.
